{{Top|leg}}
A '''hyperspace collapse''' was a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspatial]] phenomenon that referred to a momentary collapse of a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]. Hyperspace routes in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] were known to collapse without warning. A [[Starship/Legends|starship]] traveling along the hyperspace corridor during the [[Nanosecond/Legends|nanosecond]] before it re-formed would be lost forever.<ref name="RoT">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref>
